docs.title: PalSupervisor Wiki 🎮🛡️
docs.text:
Enterprise Native Supervisor, Proactive Anti-Cheat & Event Engine for Palworld Dedicated Servers

Welcome to the official documentation wiki for PalSupervisor-DLL. PalSupervisor is engineered in high-performance C++20 as a drop-in native extension (version.dll) integrating directly with the Unreal Engine 5.1.1 runtime.

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• ⚡ Sub-Microsecond Memory Detours: Hooks directly into UObject::ProcessEvent and CDO functions with zero tick delay or TPS degradation.
  • 🛡️ Proactive Anti-Cheat Matrix: Real-time detection of speed manipulation, infinite stamina, illegal damage spikes, and spoofed network packets.
  • 💬 116+ Native In-Game Commands: Full moderation, inventory editing, instant teleportation, and player state manipulation.
  • 👑 Dynamic Boss & Raid Engine: Summon custom multi-tier boss encounters from JSON templates with minions, custom loot tables, and broadcast banners.
  • 🧹 Autonomous Server Janitor: Scheduled sweeps to demolish abandoned wild structures and purge ground item clutter.
  • 🌐 Embedded REST API: Built-in HTTP daemon on port 27020 for remote bot integration and web dashboard management.

docs.title: What Are Commands?
docs.text: Commands are special text-based instructions that allow server administrators to interact with PalServer in real time. Commands start with a / (customizable in config.json) followed by the command name and optional arguments.

docs.title: Who Can Use Commands?
docs.text:
Commands marked as Admin require the executing player to be listed in admin_steam_ids or authenticated via the REST API. Commands marked as All can be executed by any connected player.

Command Syntax Guide

/command_name <required_argument> [optional_argument={default}]

  • <required_argument> → Must be included when executing the command.
  • [optional_argument] → Optional parameter. If omitted, default server value is used.

docs.title: Moderation
docs.text:
/kick

Syntax: /kick <player> [reason] Description: Kick a player from the server. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/kick Smooth "AFK in spawn"
/kick 76561198000000000

/ban

Syntax: /ban <player> [reason] Description: Permanently ban a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/ban CheaterPlayer "Speedhacking detected"

/unban

Syntax: /unban <player/uid/ip> Description: Remove a ban on a player UID or IP address. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player/uid/ip> [Required] — Parameter: player/uid/ip

Example: 

/unban 76561198000000000

/banlist

Syntax: /banlist Description: Display list of all banned players. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/banlist

/whitelist

Syntax: /whitelist <on|off|add|remove|list> [player] Description: Manage server whitelist access control. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <on|off|add|remove|list> [Required] — State toggle ('on' or 'off'). * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/whitelist <on|off|add|remove|list> [player]

/warn

Syntax: /warn <player> <message> Description: Send a formal warning and record a violation. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <message> [Required] — Message string to broadcast or send to player.

Example: 

/warn <player> <message>

/freeze

Syntax: /freeze <player> [seconds] Description: Disable player input. 0 = until /unfreeze. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [seconds] [Optional] — Duration in seconds (0 = permanent / until manual unmute).

Example: 

/freeze <player> [seconds]

/unfreeze

Syntax: /unfreeze <player> Description: Re-enable input for a frozen player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/unfreeze <player>

/mute

Syntax: /mute <player> [seconds] Description: Block a player from sending chat. 0 = permanent. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [seconds] [Optional] — Duration in seconds (0 = permanent / until manual unmute).

Example: 

/mute <player> [seconds]

/unmute

Syntax: /unmute <player> Description: Restore chat for a muted player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/unmute <player>

/kickall

Syntax: /kickall [reason] Description: Kick all non-admin players from the server. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [reason] [Optional] — Text explanation for the kick/ban action.

Example: 

/kickall [reason]

docs.title: Player & Cheats
docs.text:
/godmode

Syntax: /godmode <player> [on|off] Description: Toggle invincibility for a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * [on|off] [Optional] — State toggle ('on' or 'off').

Example: 

/godmode
/godmode Smooth on
/godmode Smooth off

/adminweapon (aliases: /godweapon, /onehit)

Syntax: /adminweapon [on|off|give] [player] Description: Toggle Admin One-Hit Kill/Destroy Weapon mode (bypasses all shields, armor & destroys any entity/object). Aliases: /godweapon, /onehit Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [on|off|give] [Optional] — State toggle ('on' or 'off'). * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/adminweapon
/adminweapon on
/adminweapon give Smooth

/heal

Syntax: /heal [player] Description: Restore a player to full HP. Defaults to self. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/heal
/heal Smooth

/sethp

Syntax: /sethp <player> <amount> Description: Set a player's exact HP via CheatManager. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <amount> [Required] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/sethp Smooth 1500

/setsp (aliases: /setstamina)

Syntax: /setsp <player> <amount> Description: Set a player's exact SP (stamina) via CheatManager. Aliases: /setstamina Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <amount> [Required] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/setsp Smooth 800

/respawn

Syntax: /respawn [player] Description: Force-respawn a player via CheatManager. Defaults to self. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/respawn
/respawn Smooth

/setlevel

Syntax: /setlevel [player] <1-80|max> Description: Set player level directly (up to 80+). Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <1-80|max> [Required] — Parameter: 1-80|max

Example: 

/setlevel Smooth 55
/setlevel max

/resetlevel

Syntax: /resetlevel [player] Description: Reset player to Level 1 and 0 EXP. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/resetlevel Smooth

/resetstats (aliases: /respec)

Syntax: /resetstats [player] Description: Refund all allocated player stat points back to unallocated status points. Aliases: /respec Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/resetstats Smooth

/clearstats

Syntax: /clearstats [player] Description: Wipe all allocated and unspent status points to 0. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/clearstats Smooth

/setmaxweight

Syntax: /setmaxweight [player] <weight> Description: Override maximum inventory carrying weight. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <weight> [Required] — Carrying weight capacity limit.

Example: 

/setmaxweight Smooth 50000

/rename

Syntax: /rename [player] <NewNickname> Description: Change player's in-game nickname. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <NewNickname> [Required] — New character display name.

Example: 

/rename Smooth "Overlord"

/kill

Syntax: /kill [player] Description: Kill a player (instant lethal death drop). Defaults to self. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/kill
/kill Smooth

/knock

Syntax: /knock [player] Description: Knock a player into DBNO bleedout state (0 HP). Defaults to self. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/knock
/knock Smooth

docs.title: Teleportation
docs.text:
/tp

Syntax: /tp <player> <x> <y> <z> or <player> <destplayer> Description: Teleport a player to coordinates or another player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * or [Required] — Parameter: or * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <destplayer> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp Smooth -291200 253700 -1990
/tp Smooth AdminPlayer

/tpme

Syntax: /tpme <player> Description: Teleport yourself to a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tpme Smooth

/tp2me

Syntax: /tp2me <player> Description: Pull a player to your location. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp2me Smooth

/spectate

Syntax: /spectate <player> Description: Spectate a player in admin mode. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/spectate Smooth

/tp2treasure

Syntax: /tp2treasure [grade 1-5] Description: Teleport to the nearest unopened wilderness treasure chest (optionally of specific grade). Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [grade 1-5] [Optional] — Level grade from 1 to 5.

Example: 

/tp2treasure
/tp2treasure 5

/tp2deathbag

Syntax: /tp2deathbag <player> Description: Teleport directly to a player's lost death drop bag. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/tp2deathbag Smooth

docs.title: Inventory & Items
docs.text:
/giveitem (aliases: /givei)

Syntax: /giveitem <player> <itemid> [amount] Description: Give items to a player. Aliases: /givei Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <itemid> [Required] — Item static ID (e.g. PalSphere, Wood, Diamond). * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/giveitem Smooth PalSphere 50
/giveitem Smooth AncientTechnologyPoint 5

/rewardi (aliases: /rewarditem, /itemreward)

Syntax: /rewardi [player|all] <item_name_or_id> [amount] Description: Reward items to inventory with native animated reward cards and HUD log. Aliases: /rewarditem, /itemreward Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player|all] [Optional] — Parameter: player|all * <item_name_or_id> [Required] — Item static ID (e.g. PalSphere, Wood, Diamond). * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/rewardi all PalSphere 25
/rewardi Smooth Diamond 5

/repair

Syntax: /repair <player> Description: Restore full durability to all equipped weapons, armor, and gliders. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/repair Smooth

/inspectinv

Syntax: /inspectinv <player> Description: Inspect a player's common inventory items, quantities, and durability. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/inspectinv Smooth

/clearinv

Syntax: /clearinv <player> Description: Clear all items from a player's common inventory. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/clearinv Smooth

/takeitem (aliases: /removeitem)

Syntax: /takeitem [player] <item_id> [amount] Description: Remove a specified item and quantity (or all) from a player's inventory. Aliases: /removeitem Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <item_id> [Required] — Parameter: item_id * [amount] [Optional] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/takeitem Smooth Wood 100
/takeitem Smooth Diamond

docs.title: Pals & NPCs
docs.text:
/rewardp (aliases: /rewardpal, /palreward)

Syntax: /rewardp [player|all] <pal_name_or_id> [level] [rank] Description: Reward a Pal to Party/PalBox with native capture visuals. Aliases: /rewardpal, /palreward Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player|all] [Optional] — Parameter: player|all * <pal_name_or_id> [Required] — Parameter: pal_name_or_id * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+. * [rank] [Optional] — Condensation star rank (0 to 4).

Example: 

/rewardp all JetDragon 50 4
/rewardp Smooth Anubis 40 2

/revivepals

Syntax: /revivepals <player> Description: Revive and fully restore HP, hunger, and sanity of all party Pals. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/revivepals Smooth

/wipepals

Syntax: /wipepals <player> Description: Clear all Pals from a player's active party. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/wipepals Smooth

/givepal (aliases: /givep)

Syntax: /givepal [player] <PalID> [level] [rank] Description: Spawn and add a Pal directly to a player's party. Aliases: /givep Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+. * [rank] [Optional] — Condensation star rank (0 to 4).

Example: 

/givepal Smooth JetDragon 50 4
/givepal SheepBall 1

/givenpc (aliases: /given)

Syntax: /givenpc [player] <NpcID> [level] Description: Add a human NPC directly to a player's party / PalBox. Aliases: /given Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/givenpc Smooth Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50

/spawnp (aliases: /spawnpal)

Syntax: /spawnp [player] <PalID> [level] Description: Spawn a wild Pal in the world next to a player. Aliases: /spawnpal Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/spawnp SheepBall 5
/spawnp Smooth JetDragon 50

/spawnw

Syntax: /spawnw <PalID> <level> <x> <y> <z> Description: Spawn a wild Pal in the world at specific coordinates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <PalID> [Required] — Internal Pal species ID (e.g. SheepBall, JetDragon, Anubis). * <level> [Required] — Level from 1 to 60+. * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters).

Example: 

/spawnw SheepBall 15 -291200 253700 -1990

/spawnnpcp (aliases: /spawnnpc)

Syntax: /spawnnpcp [player] <NpcID> [level] Description: Spawn an active human NPC in front of a player. Aliases: /spawnnpc Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * [level] [Optional] — Level from 1 to 60+.

Example: 

/spawnnpcp Smooth Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50

/spawnnpcw

Syntax: /spawnnpcw <NpcID> <level> <x> <y> <z> Description: Spawn an active human NPC at specific world coordinates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <NpcID> [Required] — Human NPC entity ID (e.g. Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5). * <level> [Required] — Level from 1 to 60+. * <x> [Required] — World coordinate axis X (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <y> [Required] — World coordinate axis Y (in Unreal Engine centimeters). * <z> [Required] — World coordinate axis Z (in Unreal Engine centimeters).

Example: 

/spawnnpcw Police_Rifle_Crime_Lv5 50 -291200 253700 -1990

/takepal (aliases: /removepal)

Syntax: /takepal [player] <pal_id|slot_1-5> [count] Description: Remove a specified Pal species or specific party slot (1-5) from a player. Aliases: /removepal Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <pal_id|slot_1-5> [Required] — Level grade from 1 to 5. * [count] [Optional] — Parameter: count

Example: 

/takepal Smooth 1
/takepal Smooth SheepBall 1

/palparty (aliases: /inspectpals)

Syntax: /palparty [player] Description: Inspect a player's active Pal party (slots, level, IVs, rank, passives). Aliases: /inspectpals Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/palparty Smooth

docs.title: Bosses & Raids
docs.text:
/listtemplates

Syntax: /listtemplates Description: List all loaded Pal and Boss encounter templates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/listtemplates

/reloadtemplates

Syntax: /reloadtemplates Description: Reload custom templates from PalSupervisor/Templates json files. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/reloadtemplates

/givecustom (aliases: /rewardcustom)

Syntax: /givecustom [player] <template_name> Description: Give custom Pal directly to player party / PalBox (reads pal_data only). Aliases: /rewardcustom Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <template_name> [Required] — Name of the boss/Pal JSON template in PalSupervisor/Templates/.

Example: 

/givecustom Smooth AlphaBoss

/spawncustom (aliases: /spawncustomp)

Syntax: /spawncustom [player] <template_name> [distance={500}] Description: Spawn custom Pal from template into the world in front of a player or caller. Aliases: /spawncustomp Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID. Defaults to caller in chat. Required for console/RCON. * <template_name> [Required] — Name of the boss/Pal JSON template in PalSupervisor/Templates/. * [distance] [Optional] — Spawn distance in front of player in centimeters (default: 500).

Example: 

/spawncustom CustomShadowbeak
/spawncustom Smooth CustomShadowbeak 600
/spawncustomp 76561198000000000 CustomShadowbeak

/spawncustomw

Syntax: /spawncustomw <template_name> <x> <y> [z] Description: Spawn custom Pal from template at in-game map coordinates. If Z is omitted, automatically detects and snaps to the floor. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <template_name> [Required] — Name of the boss/Pal JSON template in PalSupervisor/Templates/. * <x> [Required] — In-game map coordinate X. * <y> [Required] — In-game map coordinate Y. * [z] [Optional] — In-game map coordinate Z. If omitted, automatically snaps to floor level.

Example: 

/spawncustomw CustomShadowbeak 313.4 -217.9
/spawncustomw CustomShadowbeak 130.1 -445.9 -4.1

/spawnboss (aliases: /spawnbossp)

Syntax: /spawnboss [player] <template_name> [distance={1000}] Description: Summon full Boss Encounter with minions, loot engine, scaled stats, and announcements in front of a player or caller. Aliases: /spawnbossp Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name, Steam ID, or UID. Defaults to caller in chat. Required for console/RCON. * <template_name> [Required] — Name of the boss/Pal JSON template in PalSupervisor/Templates/. * [distance] [Optional] — Spawn distance in front of target player (default: 1000).

Example: 

/spawnboss AlphaBoss
/spawnboss Smooth AlphaBoss 1200
/spawnbossp 76561198000000000 AlphaBoss

/spawnbossw

Syntax: /spawnbossw <template_name> <x> <y> [z] Description: Summon full Boss Encounter at in-game map coordinates. If Z is omitted, automatically detects ground elevation and snaps the boss and all minions to the floor. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <template_name> [Required] — Name of the boss/Pal JSON template in PalSupervisor/Templates/. * <x> [Required] — In-game map coordinate X (e.g. 313.4). * <y> [Required] — In-game map coordinate Y (e.g. -217.9). * [z] [Optional] — In-game map coordinate Z. If omitted, automatically snaps to ground level.

Example: 

/spawnbossw AlphaBoss 313.4 -217.9
/spawnbossw AlphaBoss 522.4 -159.6 7.0

/killboss (aliases: /despawnboss)

Syntax: /killboss [player] [radius={5000}] Description: Despawn active summoned bosses and their minions immediately. Can target around a player or despawn all active encounters globally. Aliases: /despawnboss Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID whose vicinity to clear. If omitted, clears around caller (or all globally if run from console). * [radius] [Optional] — Search radius around player (default: 5000).

Example: 

/killboss
/killboss Smooth
/killboss Smooth 8000

/bosses

Syntax: /bosses Description: Query world boss spawners, alive/dead state, and coordinates. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/bosses

/respawnboss

Syntax: /respawnboss <boss_name|spawner_name|all> Description: Force an immediate respawn of an Alpha boss or spawner. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <boss_name|spawner_name|all> [Required] — Parameter: boss_name|spawner_name|all

Example: 

/respawnboss all
/respawnboss Kingpaca

/raid

Syntax: /raid [player] Description: Trigger an invader march / raid against a player's nearest base camp. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * [player] [Optional] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000).

Example: 

/raid Smooth

/stopraid

Syntax: /stopraid Description: Cancel all active enemy invasion raids. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * None

Example: 

/stopraid

docs.title: Progression & Unlocks
docs.text:
/giveexp

Syntax: /giveexp <player> <amount> Description: Give experience points to a player. Permissions: In-Game Chat, REST API, Admin Only

Arguments: * <player> [Required] — Target player name or Steam ID (e.g. Smooth, 76561198000000000). * <amount> [Required] — Quantity count (e.g. 1, 50, 1000).

Example: 

/giveexp Smooth 50000

docs.title: Features & Architecture ⚡🛡️
docs.text: PalSupervisor operates as an in-process native supervisor for Palworld dedicated servers (PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe). Engineered in high-performance C++20, PalSupervisor hooks directly into Unreal Engine 5.1.1 runtime memory via a non-intrusive Windows proxy DLL (version.dll).

docs.title: 1. Engine Detour Hooking & Zero-Tick Architecture
docs.text:
• Direct ProcessEvent Interception: Detours player RPCs and engine dispatch tables before server gameplay logic processes them, allowing instant sanitization of malicious network packets.
  • No Disk Modification: Hooks game memory dynamically upon server boot. No game files or executable binaries are patched on disk.
  • Zero Overhead: Detour hook execution overhead is measured under 0.02 milliseconds per tick, preserving 100% server tick rate (TPS).

docs.title: 2. Autonomous Server Janitor & Audit Trail 🧹
docs.text:
• Orphaned Wild Structure Demolition: Automatically detects and dismantles structures built outside official guild base camp circles, freeing up physics memory and actor limits.
  • Loose Ground Drop Purging: Sweeps abandoned ground item drops (DropItem) at scheduled intervals to prevent RAM bloat and physics clutter.
  • Deathbag Cleanup & Age Retention: Purges player death corpse containers exceeding configurable age limits (deathbag_max_age_minutes), preventing deathbag hoarding from degrading server tick rates.
  • Live In-Memory Audit Trail: Records up to 500 recent swept items in an in-memory ring buffer accessible via GET /api/janitor/swept and in-game command /janitor history. Captures item category, item name, quantity, owner UID, owner player name, UE world coordinates, and in-game map coordinates.
  • Manual & Automated Sweeps: Supports background timers as well as instant manual sweeps with customizable criteria and dry-run mode via POST /api/janitor/run.

docs.title: 3. Real-Time Spatial Live Map & Entity Radar 🗺️
docs.text:
• Full-World Entity Indexing: Continuously indexes live world entities including loose loot, player death corpse containers, wild dropped Pal spheres, world treasure chests, dungeon chests, wild Pal eggs, supply drop capsules/meteorites, and unowned player structures.
  • Calibrated Dual-Coordinate Projection: Projects raw 3D Unreal Engine centimeter vectors into standard Palworld in-game map coordinates ($X, Y$) matching the player HUD map ($X = ext{WorldX} \times 0.002179 - 344$, $Y = ext{WorldY} \times 0.002179 + 270$).
  • One-Click Deathbag Recovery: Direct item restoration from deathbags into player inventories via POST /api/map/recoverbag or in-game command /recoverbag.

docs.title: 4. Proactive Anti-Cheat Matrix 🛡️
docs.text:
• Movement & Delta-Position Validation: Calculates delta position over delta time to detect speed hacking, fly hacking, and illegal coordinate teleportation.
  • Stamina & Stat Sanitization: Detects and clamps impossible stamina values, health spikes, and unearned stat points.
  • Illegal Item & Pal Detection: Filters out unobtainable or blacklisted item IDs and illegal Pal passives.
  • Evidence Logging & Webhooks: Maintains an active violation score per player, triggers auto-bans when thresholds are breached, and dispatches rich embed alerts to Discord webhooks.

docs.title: 5. Dynamic Boss & Encounter Engine 👑
docs.text:
• Template-Driven Boss Spawns: Define custom multi-tier boss encounters in PalSupervisor/Templates/*.json with custom hitpoints, minions, level scaling, and drop tables.
  • Invasion Raid Management: Trigger, monitor, or immediately cancel base camp raid events with /raid and /stopraid.
  • Supply Drops & Meteorites: Trigger on-demand supply capsules or meteorite strikes at specific coordinates or target players.

docs.title: 6. Native Embedded REST API 🌐
docs.text:
• High-Speed HTTP Daemon: Lightweight, multi-threaded C++ REST API listening on port 27020 (http://127.0.0.1:27020).
  • Complete Administrative Suite: Over 120 endpoints providing full server control, player moderation, inventory grants, cheat toggles, and live radar feeds for dashboard managers and Discord bots.

docs.title: Installation Guide
docs.text: PalSupervisor requires no external mod loaders, UE4SS, or complex dependencies.

docs.title: Step 1: Deploy version.dll
docs.text:
Copy version.dll directly next to the PalServer binary: 

PalServer\Pal\Binaries\Win64\version.dll

docs.title: Step 2: Configure config.json
docs.text:
Place your customized config.json in the same directory: 

PalServer\Pal\Binaries\Win64\config.json

Example configuration: 

{
  "version": "0.4.1",
  "chat": {
    "command_prefix": "/",
    "enable_chat_commands": true,
    "admin_steam_ids": [
      "76561198000000000"
    ]
  },
  "api": {
    "enabled": true,
    "port": 27020,
    "bind_address": "0.0.0.0"
  },
  "anticheat": {
    "speed_check": true,
    "stamina_check": true,
    "auto_ban_threshold": 5
  },
  "janitor": {
    "enabled": true,
    "sweep_interval_minutes": 30
  }
}

docs.title: Step 3: Launch Server
docs.text:
Start your dedicated server normally: 

PalServer-Win64-Shipping-Cmd.exe
PalSupervisor will initialize automatically upon server startup.

docs.title: Step 4: Verify
docs.text: Type /help in in-game chat or visit http://127.0.0.1:27020/health in your browser.

docs.title: Embedded REST API Reference 🌐
docs.text: PalSupervisor embeds a native high-performance, non-blocking HTTP server listening on port 27020 (customizable in config.json). The API allows server management dashboards, Discord bots, and remote administrative tools to monitor and control PalServer with zero tick degradation.

docs.title: Authentication & Security
docs.text:
Administrative endpoints require authentication via one of the following methods:

  1. Header X-API-Key: Matches the api.api_key configured in config.json (Default: changeme-admin-key).
  2. Header Authorization: Bearer <token>: JWT token obtained from POST /auth/login.

Example request: 

GET /api/players HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:27020
X-API-Key: changeme-admin-key

docs.title: 1. System & Health
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description Auth GET /health Server heartbeat, uptime, FPS, tick rate, and supervisor version. Public GET /metrics Detailed performance metrics, memory consumption, and active entity counts. Public GET /server/stats Real-time player counts, day/night world clock, and loaded actors. Public POST /auth/login Authenticate with administrator password to receive a session token. Public

docs.title: 2. Spatial Live Map & World Entity Radar 🗺️
docs.text: PalSupervisor provides high-speed spatial entity scanning across the entire Palworld map. All entities return dual-coordinate formatting: * location: Exact Unreal Engine 3D world vector (x, y, z in centimeters). * game_coords: In-game calibrated map grid coordinates (x, y, z matching the player HUD map).

docs.title: Map Endpoints
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /api/map/entities Scans all world entities. Query params: ?type=all\|loot\|deathbags\|pals\|treasures\|chests\|supplies\|wildbuilds\|eggs and ?filter=<text>. GET /api/map/loot Returns all loose dropped ground items, quantities, and coordinates. (Alias: /api/map/drops). GET /api/map/deathbags Returns all player death corpse bags, containing PlayerUID, SteamID, items list, age, and location. GET /api/map/pals Returns all dropped or wild Pal sphere actors. (Alias: /api/map/droppedpals). GET /api/map/treasures Returns all world treasure chests, rank levels, and locations. GET /api/map/chests Returns all dungeon and open-world interactive chests. GET /api/map/supplies Returns active supply drop capsules and meteorite crates. GET /api/map/wildbuilds Returns all player structures built outside designated base camp borders. GET /api/map/eggs Returns all wild Pal eggs. POST /api/map/recoverbag Recovers a player's deathbag items directly back into their inventory. Payload: {"player_id": "<SteamID or UID>"}.

docs.title: 3. Autonomous Janitor & Sweep Audit 🧹
docs.text:
The PalSupervisor Janitor autonomously demolishes orphaned wild structures, sweeps ground clutter, and purges abandoned deathbags based on configurable rules.

Method Endpoint Description GET /api/janitor/status Returns Janitor operational status, total sweeps executed, items swept, and last sweep timestamp. GET /api/janitor/config Retrieves the current active Janitor configuration. POST /api/janitor/config Hot-updates Janitor configuration rules (intervals, cleanup flags, max retention age). POST /api/janitor/run Triggers an immediate manual sweep. Payload supports custom overrides (see below). GET /api/janitor/swept Returns the live audit trail of the last 500 swept items (name, count, owner, coords, timestamp).

docs.title: Manual Sweep Request Payload
docs.text:
{
  "clean_drops": true,
  "clean_wild_builds": true,
  "clean_deathbags": false,
  "deathbag_max_age_minutes": 120,
  "dry_run": false
}

docs.text:
{
  "total_swept": 1,
  "items": [
    {
      "timestamp": 1726145600,
      "category": "DeathBag",
      "name": "DeathBag",
      "count": 1,
      "owner_uid": "1A2B3C4D000000000000000000000000",
      "owner_name": "Smooth",
      "location": { "x": -123456.0, "y": 234567.0, "z": 1250.0 },
      "game_coords": { "x": -613.0, "y": 781.0, "z": 12.5 }
    }
  ]
}

docs.title: 4. Player Moderation & Management 🛡️
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /players List all connected players with coordinates, Steam ID, PlayerUID, ping, and guild. GET /players/all List all registered players (both online and offline historical save data). GET /players/{uid} Detailed inspect profile for a specific player (stats, inventory, active pals). POST /admin/kick Kicks a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>", "reason": "<text>"}. POST /admin/ban Bans a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>", "reason": "<text>"}. POST /admin/unban Unbans a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/IP/SteamID>"}. POST /admin/mute Chat mutes a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>", "duration": 300}. POST /admin/unmute Unmutes a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>"}. POST /admin/freeze Immobilizes a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>", "duration": 60}. POST /admin/unfreeze Restores player movement. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>"}. POST /admin/kill Kills a player. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>"}. POST /admin/wanted Sets wanted bounty level. Payload: {"player": "<UID/Name>", "level": 3}.

docs.title: 5. Player Cheats & State Modification ⚡
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description POST /admin/give/item Gives items to player. Payload: {"player": "...", "item_id": "...", "count": 1}. POST /admin/give/exp Grants player experience. Payload: {"player": "...", "exp": 50000}. POST /admin/give/techpoints Grants technology points. Payload: {"player": "...", "points": 10}. POST /admin/give/stats Grants unspent attribute points. Payload: {"player": "...", "points": 5}. POST /admin/heal Instantly heals player HP, hunger, and sanity. Payload: {"player": "..."}. POST /admin/godmode Toggles invincible godmode. Payload: {"player": "...", "enabled": true}. POST /admin/repair Fully repairs all equipped weapons, armor, and inventory tools. POST /admin/paldex/complete Unlocks 100% Paldeck discovery entries for player. POST /admin/map/unlock Fully clears fog-of-war across the entire map for player. POST /admin/teleport Teleports player to coordinates or another player.

docs.title: 6. Guilds & Base Camps 🏰
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /api/guilds List all guilds, member rosters, leader, and base camp locations. GET /api/guild/info Detailed guild profile by Guild ID or Name. POST /admin/guild/rename Force rename a guild. Payload: {"guild_id": "...", "new_name": "..."}. POST /admin/guild/setleader Appoints a new guild leader. Payload: {"guild_id": "...", "player_id": "..."}. POST /admin/guild/disband Disbands a guild. Payload: {"guild_id": "..."}. POST /admin/base/killnearest Destroys the nearest base camp to an admin or coordinate. GET /admin/base/chests Inspects all storage container contents inside a base camp. GET /admin/base/pals Inspects all working Pals stationed inside a base camp.

docs.title: 7. Dynamic Bosses, Raids & World Events 👑
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /api/bosses List all active world bosses, levels, health, and spawn cooldowns. POST /admin/boss/spawn Spawns a boss encounter from a template. Payload: {"template": "...", "coords": {...}}. POST /admin/boss/respawn Resets cooldown on a world boss. Payload: {"boss_id": "..."}. GET /api/raids Returns current active enemy base raids. POST /admin/raid/trigger Forces an immediate base raid invasion. Payload: {"base_id": "..."}. POST /admin/raid/stop Terminates an ongoing raid event. POST /admin/supply/drop Triggers a supply drop capsule or meteor event at coordinates or player.

docs.title: 8. In-Game Broadcasts & Alerts 📢
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description POST /admin/broadcast Scrolling system broadcast banner across all players' screens. POST /admin/alert Center modal notification dialog sent to a specific player. POST /admin/alertall Center modal notification dialog sent to all connected players. POST /admin/command Executes any in-game command via JSON payload: {"command": "/help"}.

docs.title: 9. Proactive Anti-Cheat & Violations 🛡️
docs.text: Method Endpoint Description GET /violations List all active player violation records, detection flags, and severity counts. GET /api/anticheat/logs Query chronological anti-cheat detection logs with filtering. POST /api/anticheat/clear Clear violation records for a player or all players. GET /api/anticheat/config View active anti-cheat thresholds (speed delta, stamina limit, ban threshold).
